_comment: Machines are assembled from optional components; see src/sim/machine_world.gd. Rates are per in-game minute. Power in pw, water in cell-volumes.

old_well.name: Wick Well
old_well.desc: The town hand pump. Crank it and the cistern answers — if the line holds.

wick_mains.name: Wick Mains
wick_mains.desc: Old gravity lines from the cistern to every house in Wick.

station_pump.name: Station 7 Pump
station_pump.desc: The great pump. Built to lift a river. Dead since the Sump flood, eleven years ago.

intake.name: Pipe Intake
intake.desc: A strainer for the end of a pipe. Sits in water; feeds the line when something pulls.

pump.name: Electric Pump
pump.desc: Pulls water out of whatever it stands in and pushes it down the pipe.

outlet.name: Pipe Outlet
outlet.desc: Lets the pipe empty into the space around it.

burner.name: Glowbeet Burner
burner.desc: Burns beets or resin for strong, steady power. Runs hot and breathes out sour gas.

turbine.name: Drip Turbine
turbine.desc: Glowglass vanes in falling water. Clean, quiet, and only as strong as the fall.

crank.name: Crank Dynamo
crank.desc: Turn the handle; get power. Builds character, according to Barnaby.

heat_cell.name: Heat Cell
heat_cell.desc: Thermal ore in a brass jacket. Stores power; warms up while charging.

lamp.name: Glow Lamp
lamp.desc: A glowglass bulb on a post. Crops need light; so do people.

sprinkler.name: Sprinkler
sprinkler.desc: Sits on the surface and wets the soil around it. Too much and the plots drown.

scrubber.name: Moss Scrubber
scrubber.desc: Draws foul air through a moss filter. Wet work: it needs water, power and fresh pads. Leaves sludge.

fan.name: Vent Fan
fan.desc: Pushes air one way. Where it goes is somebody's business.

exchanger.name: Heat Exchanger
exchanger.desc: Thermal ore fins that lift heat from below to the space above.

tank.name: Water Tank
tank.desc: Holds water for when the pumps can't keep up.

lift_winch.name: Primary Lift Winch
lift_winch.desc: STN-7 PRIMARY LIFT. A cable drum the size of a cart, a brake, and a cage somewhere below. The cable rotted away years ago.
